title: harvard & aliens & crackpots: a disambiguation of Avi Loeb
summary: Physicist Angela Collier gives an hour-long critique of Avi Loeb's alien claims and reputation, placing them within the broader topic of physics crackpots. The Loeb discussion starts around the 24 minute mark.
why: Frequently linked as an in-depth, well-presented skeptical take whenever Loeb's alien claims come up.

quote.text: I was surprised about myself that I watched the entire thing and I guess it's because of the high quality of the presentation
